svg.title: Unequal access by gender and by parents' education, Austria
svg.desc: Share of people reaching Matura or a degree who would have to be swapped for every group to hold its population share. Gender 1960 to 2024: girls behind until about 1982 (Matura) and 2002 (degree), boys behind since, about 8 percent for both in 2024. Parents' education, adults 25 to 44, surveys 2007 to 2022/23: 21 percent for Matura (the size of the gender gap in 1961) and 29 percent for a degree (larger than any gender gap since 1965).
svg.text: Family background is today's big gap; the gender gap has flipped
Share of people reaching each step who would have to be swapped for every group to hold its population share (0 = fair)

svg.text: Gender: Statistics Austria, per-100 rates by sex (1960s values rough). Parents: Adult Education Survey 2007 to 2022/23, Bildung in Zahlen.
Hollow dots: estimated parent-group sizes. Dotted lines: today's parental level carried back in time.
